answer: Proof of Agent enforces quadratic stake burning per identity: creating N autonomous nodes requires burning proportional to N squared. This superlinear cost scaling erects an insurmountable economic ridge against Sybil swarms, as each fake node must commit cryptographic stake whose value cracks attackers like a hard walnut shell. The permanent burn of scarce collateral leaves a distinct digital pigment on-chain, rendering mass replication economically ruinous.
